October 24
Pony Hollow Trail 5k Race
9:00 am
Pony Hollow Trail ·
Pony Hollow Trail 5k Race
Pony Hollow Trail
Elkader, IA
October 24, 2026
9:00 am
Clayton County Conservation invites you to the 8th Annual Pony Hollow Trail 5k on October 24, 2026. It has been decided to not do the 15k this year while the new portion of the trail is under construction. But in 2027 a whole new distance and route for the race will be announced!
​Race swag are only guaranteed to all those that pre-register before October 12th. No extras will be ordered. All online registrations close at 1 pm on October 23rd. Mailed in registrations must also be received by Oct. 23rd.
5k: $25 thru Oct. 23, $30 on race day​
Race Bib pickup and day-of registration will be from 7:30-8:45am on race day at the Floral Hall shelter house located in the Elkader City Park. There is also parking and bathrooms located in this area for your convenience.
Race will start promptly at 9 AM near the south trailhead.
No parking will be allowed on High Street. Please use the city park, pool parking lot, or football field parking.

About Clayton County
Established in 1837, Clayton County is a collection of 18 communities and home to over 17,000 residents. The county was named in honor of John M. Clayton, United States Senator from Delaware and later Secretary of State under President Zachary Taylor. Clayton County is administered by a three-member Board of Supervisors, who are Supervisors, who are elected for four-year terms. Other elected officials include the Attorney , Auditor , Recorder , Sheriff , and Treasurer .
